criterio_pre_registrado.pergunta: Does the ordering 'proposed - FABDEM > 0 in MAE above 30 m', paired by transect, survive a PER-CELL shift of the reference of the size of delta_c?
criterio_pre_registrado.dado: Population from auditar_nmad_pareado_nativa_diretas.json: judgeable forest, ETH class >30 m, per-cell error reconstructed as in the NMAD audit; delta_c ONLY from delta_escala_celulas_nativa.parquet, joined on (transecto,quad,idx_no); area-grid proxy FORBIDDEN
criterio_pre_registrado.bracos: g'_c=g_c+lambda*delta_c, lambda in {0;0.25;0.5;0.75;1} in the physical direction; direction control lambda in {-0.5;-1}; stress test with delta = upper CI bound of the transect; the common-shift guard reproduces the invariance of 13/09; the positive control reverses by construction
criterio_pre_registrado.estatistica: same as the NMAD auditor (REF.testar): median of per-transect MAE differences, bootstrap B=10000 seed 42, Wilcoxon, sign test, Holm (singleton in this run)
criterio_pre_registrado.guarda_de_reproducao: lambda=0 reproduces testes_principal_ETH['v23 vs fabdem'].mae['>30m'].mediana_m=+2.3259 CI[+1.780;+2.616] to within 1e-6, sha256 checked before computing
criterio_pre_registrado.controle_positivo: per-cell offset injected into FABDEM that reverses the ranking by construction; the script reports the reversal
criterio_pre_registrado.criterio: sentence kept if for EVERY lambda in [0;1] of the grid the 95% CI of the median excludes 0 and p_holm<0.05; if it fails at some lambda, the sentence gains 'for reference offsets up to lambda_max*delta' (grid not refined); if it already fails at lambda=0.25, the sentence is removed from the abstract
criterio_pre_registrado.dono_do_desenho: Design scope of this check: ranking statistics, native delta, and sign convention.
criterio_pre_registrado.acrescimo_do_dono_28_09: ANADEM enters as an additional product, same path as auditar_nmad_pareado_nativa_anadem.py, same rule, no new criterion; results conditional on a pending independent recomputation
